x: CRANFORD - Fastest times:- P.Whewell (S.A) 16:07, W.Olivier (S.A) 16:10, R.Winter (Bristol 'B') 16:23, M.Price (Bristol) 16:24, A.Ashton (Reading) 16:24, J.Hogan (Poly H) 16:26.

Run in sunshine, as opposed to last year's snow storm, the Maidenhead 10 turned out to be one of mixed fortunes for our runners, but one which gave Gerry,having led virtually from the start,a convincing win (54secs) over old rival on the road, Mick Price (Bristol).
